title: Assessment policy and risk treatment decisions need authority and follow-up evidence
remediation: The sponsor risk authority approves risk assessment and response procedures, owners, review triggers and tolerance. Sample an actual finding through assignment, accepted treatment or remediation, authorized approval and follow-up. Record scope, residual risk, review or expiry date and reassessment responsibility.

milestones.title: Collect the approved policy and a sampled finding with assigned response, disposition authority and follow-up evidence
